objective: Implement the evidence-governed authenticated subscriber workspace and complete tender operations journey on the exact subscriber UX architecture head.
outcome: A route-addressable Intelligence Shell and Operations Shell with server-authoritative capabilities, persistent bounded mutations, six-locale semantic parity, accessible interaction and exact-head test evidence, without autonomous external action or canonical UX acceptance claims.

skills.activation_reason: Prevent drift from Global Opportunity Intelligence and the subscriber-authority boundary.
Resolve the governing product, epistemic, security, API, interaction and multilingual contracts.
Keep P08-T02 typed, dependency-aware and evidence-scoped.
Separate engineering evidence from canonical and human UX acceptance.
Review tenant isolation, role authority, mutations, exports and external handoffs.
Minimise contact, document and private workspace exposure.
Define route, mutation, denial, recovery and performance evidence.
Refactor the monolithic shell into route-level product surfaces.
Define typed server-authoritative workspace APIs and persistence boundaries.
Resolve tenant, role, seat and capability state on the server.
Enforce WCAG 2.2 AA and nonvisual equivalents.
Preserve semantic parity for en, es, fr, de, pt and it.
Preserve context, URL state, browser history and explicit user control.
Keep Globe, Graph and Timeline meaningful, bounded and accessible.
Produce contract, permission, browser, visual and regression evidence.
Enforce product-shell rendering and interaction budgets.
Integrate the existing candidate billing surface without enabling live activation.
Make private memory, approvals and external handoffs explicit and reversible.

external: qualified-user usability evidence remains external and pending

allowed_scope: Authenticated product shell and route contracts
Intelligence Shell and Tender Workspace UI
Server-authoritative tenant, role, entitlement and bounded mutations
Explicit engineering fixtures with no silent fallback
Accessibility, multilingual, visual, performance and regression evidence
prohibited_scope: Client-authoritative tenant, role, entitlement or approval decisions
Silent fixture fallback or fake persisted success
Live Stripe activation, source admission, public launch or canonical UX acceptance
Changing the DeepSeek transport alias or governed checkpoint label

acceptance_evidence.description: Capability, route, permission, state, token, event and fixture boundaries are frozen before parallel implementation.
Type, component, API and permission suites pass on the exact head.
Reviewed desktop, tablet and mobile screenshots for dark and light themes.
Tenant, role, entitlement, export and handoff negative cases pass.
Qualified-user study meets the normative UX thresholds.

rollback.strategy: Revert the P08-T02 branch or disable the subscriber workspace feature flag; retain pre-existing InvestigationShell and backend ledgers.

goal_lock_checks.evidence: The workspace preserves geographic, relational and temporal investigation before tender operations.
Official, normalised, inferred, subscriber-provided, unknown and contradictory states remain distinct.
Globe and Graph remain equal lenses over one InvestigationContext and explicit user choice prevails.
Subscriber interest may prioritise investigation but cannot create evidence or an opportunity claim.
The frozen locale contract covers en, es, fr, de, pt and it with original-language evidence retained.
Workspace decisions, evidence anchors, amendments and audit state create durable product memory.
The scope excludes autonomous submission, communication, signature and client-side authority.
Rights, contact, export, privacy and tenant boundaries fail closed.
A feature flag and branch revert provide bounded rollback without deleting canonical ledgers.
This implements the authorised P08-T02 subscriber workspace engineering candidate only.
